name: Braintrust
oneLine: Active observability platform for instrumenting, understanding, and improving agents: SDKs in six languages, evals, datasets, playground.
tldrVendor: Braintrust is an eval and observability platform with dataset management, experiment tracking, a prompt playground, and span-level tracing. If you need production-grade experimentation workflows, human review, or CI-integrated regression testing, Braintrust is the deeper eval platform. Online scoring rules score production logs at span, trace or group scope.

rows.vendor: SDK imports or OpenTelemetry (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Ruby, C#)
rows.quote: we built native SDKs for Java, Go, Ruby, and C#, all built on OpenTelemetry for vendor-neutral observability

rows.vendor: Enterprise plan only; hybrid: you run the data plane, Braintrust hosts the UI
rows.quote: only available on the Enterprise plan

rows.vendor: Background-thread logging by default; synchronous flush optional
rows.quote: All logging operations run in a background thread, including api key validation, project/experiment registration, and flushing logs.

rows.vendor: LLM, code, and human scoring + datasets + experiments
rows.quote: To build them, use built-in autoevals, LLM-as-a-judge, or custom code.

rows.vendor: Latency, token counts and cost captured per span and trace; dashboards filter and group by metadata
MCP server that creates scorers and evaluators, runs evals, and edits datasets (Aug 2026)
rows.quote: create and test evaluators, build datasets, run evals, configure Topics, build monitor views, and set up alerts without moving data between tools or sharing context manually.

rows.vendor: Venture-backed company; $80M Series B led by ICONIQ (Feb 17, 2026)
rows.quote: Braintrust has raised $80M to become the observability layer for production AI. Our Series B is led by ICONIQ

rows.vendor: Dashboards track requests, latency, tokens, cost, scores, topics; filters and groupings apply to all charts
rows.quote: Use dashboards to track request counts, latency, token usage, costs, scores, topics, and custom metrics over time.

rows.vendor: Integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenTelemetry, LangGraph, CrewAI + more
rows.quote: Connect Braintrust with your AI providers and frameworks

rows.vendor: Versioned prompts (new version per save); invoke() by slug from code, pin versions in production
rows.quote: Every prompt save creates a new version with a unique ID.

rows.vendor: SOC 2 Type II, SAML SSO, BAA (HIPAA), RBAC, on-prem or hosted deployment, premium support
rows.quote: Custom data retention and export, RBAC, and premium support with on-prem or hosted deployment

rows.vendor: Starter $0/month (1 GB processed data, 10k scores, 14-day retention); Pro $249/month (5 GB, 50k scores, 30-day retention); Enterprise custom
rows.quote: Free usage is included for traces, evals, and your whole team

vendorReasons.text: You need deep eval capabilities — datasets, experiments, human review, LLM scoring
You need a prompt playground for iterating on prompts with real data
You need enterprise compliance today (SOC 2 Type II, SAML SSO, on-prem or hosted deployment)
You need multi-language SDK support (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Ruby, C#)
You need cost and token analytics you can filter and group across dashboards
You need CI/CD-integrated regression testing against production datasets

faq.question: What is the difference between Iris and Braintrust?
faq.vendorPart: Braintrust is an SDK-based eval and observability platform with datasets, experiments, a prompt playground, and CI/CD-integrated regression testing. Braintrust offers deeper evaluation workflows with LLM-as-a-judge, code scorers, and human review.

faq.question: Is Iris better than Braintrust for MCP agent evaluation?
faq.vendorPart: Braintrust requires SDK imports (or OpenTelemetry) but offers experiment workflows, dataset management, and SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Ruby, and C#.
